_about: Gamestate map, version 1 (2026-11-12). Invariants of SSBU 13.0.5 found by research/RESEARCH.md; each entry says how it was found and how far it is checked. Addresses are guest addresses of main (base 0x7100000000).

boma.what: app::BattleObjectModuleAccessor: a battle object's module accessor
boma.shape: word 0 a vptr in main's data (0x7104f17000-0x71052aa000); u32 at +8 the object id, nothing in the 4 bytes above; modules at fixed offsets (fields.py: 43 from the lua_bind getters)
boma.id: top 4 bits the category: 0 fighter, 1 weapon (articles, projectiles), 2 enemy, 3 gimmick, 4 item; 0x50000000 a free slot
boma.live: category 0-4 and its posture (+0x38), status (+0x40) and work (+0x50) modules are objects (a vptr each)
boma.active: StatusModule.status_kind != -1 (a fighter's articles are made with it and wait at -1)
boma.checked: 14 matches (6 + 8 never seen before), 2-4 fighters, 28 fighters, Nana, weapons, items, gimmicks: every fighter's status, motion, motion frame, pos x / y and damage equal to the game's getters on ~142 sampled frames each (reader.py --hash), 0 different

pools.what: blocks made by the battle object manager's set-up (allocation calls returning to 0x71014f3000-0x71014f6000), once a match
pools.checked: same sites and sizes in every run seen; every live weapon found by a whole-heap scan lies in them (3 runs)

open: the rule's item spawning (items falling on the stage): items=on sets the appearance value only
stage gimmicks (category 3) are found on Castle 64 (4 live objects); 1,944 of their named values are checked, their own fields are not named yet

items.what: app::Item objects: the fighters' own items (Diddy Kong's banana, Link's bomb) and the stage's
items.enumeration: the game's ItemManager (lib::Singleton<app::ItemManager>::instance_): lua_bind ItemManager__get_num_of_active_item_all_impl(manager) and ItemManager__get_active_item_impl(manager, index) -> the Item object
items.boma: the Item's word at +0x20 points to its boma, inside the Item (+0x98); the boma's id is 0x4xxxxxxx; it is 8-aligned, not 16 (a 16-byte scan misses it); boma vptr 0x71050757a0
items.checked: Diddy Kong's banana (54 samples) and Link's bomb (40 samples) followed from held (status 2, no hitbox) to thrown (status 5, hitboxes active), 2 runs
items.stage_items: handed to a fighter by SSBU_GIVE_ITEM (ItemModule__have_item_impl): kinds 1, 5, 9, 14, 20, 30, 45 read; the rule's own spawning not obtained

battle_objects.ground_collision_records: pool of 350 records of 0x6E0 bytes (site 0x7102606480, 616,000 bytes); GroundModule + 0x28 -> the object's record (fighter record 0); touching lines at +0x10 + 0x30 k (k 0 up, 1 left, 2 right, 3 down), status at +0x5A0 (1 ground, 2 air, 3 cliff): research/map/code_reading/GroundModule_CameraModule.json (2026-11-12 02:27)

module_fields.what: research/tools/fields.py Dictionary: for a module object's own class (its vptr), each lua_bind getter that is a pure relay to a vtable slot whose function is a plain load gives a field: name, offset, kind. 169 fields for a fighter's modules.
open: ~1,500 getters are code, not plain loads (WorkModule's tables, GroundModule, KineticModule's energies, the hitboxes' arrays)
module_fields.checked: research/tools/verify_fields.sh: every named field of every object against the game's own getter called at the same moment: 1,213,479 values equal, 0 different on 6 matches (fighters, weapons, gimmicks, items); to pass before and after any change

checked_by_invariants.what: fields read from the code (research/map/code_reading/) whose getters cannot be called by the check (they write or take references), checked by frame-to-frame invariants instead (research/tools/invariants.py, 2026-11-12 03:31): one match, 600 frame pairs; probable until more matches

GroundModule record [GM+0x28].+0x5A0: u32 ground-collision status, raw (1 ground, 2 air, 3 cliff): agrees with StatusModule.situation_kind except for one frame at a hit's launch
GroundModule record [GM+0x28].+0x10+0x30k: touching line pointers, k 0 up, 1 left, 2 right, 3 down; +0xA0 (k 3) not null whenever the status is ground

ControlModule (block = module+0x20).+0x20/+0x24, +0x50/+0x54, +0x80: previous stick, sub stick, buttons: equal to the current ones of the frame before (also checked by their getters)

KineticModule energies.+0 of each energy: class vptr as the constructor f_71006882d0 sets it, the same at every frame

script_rng.what: [[[root]]] = 9 generators of 0x14 bytes (4 xorshift128 words, a call counter): app::sv_math::rand

logic_frame.what: u32, moves once a logic frame

match_block.what: the rule at +0, the players' records at +0x580, 0x260 bytes each

globals.singletons: lib::Singleton<T>::instance_ exported for app::FighterManager, StageManager, ItemManager, BattleObjectManager, BattleObjectWorld, BattleObjectSlow, BossManager, GimmickEventPresenter, FighterCutInManager, FighterParamAccessor2, ItemParamAccessor, lib::LuaManager, lib::EffectManager

not_simulation.what: state carried between frames that the simulation's code does not read (research/tools/memtrace.py, oracle.py); not safe to leave out of a save as such (pruning experiments E3-E6)
not_simulation.lua_heap: ~1.15 MB walked by Lua 5.3's GC (f_71038ffa80 propagatemark and its family), whatever the CPU players
not_simulation.audio: the mixer thread (sdk+0x338930 -> sdk+0x334450 -> f_7103987e40) and app::SoundModule's request manager (f_71023ef100, f_71023ef2e0)
not_simulation.render: nu:: objects, per-frame render allocations (site 0x710386fd20, scratch written by f_710386fba0)
not_simulation.effects: nn::vfx: its tick (main+0x8dc80 <- 0x356dd50) crashes when its memory is not restored with the simulation's
not_simulation.gimmick_objects_castle64: the category-3 objects of Castle 64 (pool site 0x71014f534c): made in some runs only; a run with and one without them are identical, CPU against CPU (hash, 822,520 named values)

stage_state.what: per-stage objects made at the match load whose state the fight reads back (research/RESEARCH.md 2026-11-12 02:12)

sites.0x7100524308 0x7102629cb0: 288-byte blocks; count follows the stage (FD 10, Battlefield 13, Castle 64 25); 9x more state read by the simulation with hazards on

stage_state.checked: two methods: the traces (hazards on / off / FD) and held perturbations (CPU against CPU: the fight changes within 1-10 frames, on Castle 64 and on FD)
stage_state.nature: established (2026-11-12 05:18): the stage's collision geometry: A 288-byte line segments, B 96-byte vertices, C 256-byte line groups (and D 0x140-byte group transforms); the fighters' ground-collision records point to A blocks; research/map/code_reading/stage_collision.json

module_sizes: research/map/module_sizes.json: each module class's object size (the dump copies 0x900 bytes whatever the size)
allocation_sites: research/map/sites.md / sites.json: every allocation site coloured by the access trace over whole fights

carried_no_effect_observed.what: state carried from frame to frame and read by the simulation's code, whose perturbation changed neither the fight hash nor any named value: not shown to be gamestate, not shown not to be
carried_no_effect_observed.stage_table: the 1,024-entry table [[0x710532f490]] (site 0x71026054bc, 426,704 bytes): held perturbed 10 s, fight hash and every named value unchanged (2026-11-12 02:03), with a positive control; by the code reading a spatial grid of the stage's lines (f_710260e040); an injected error persists 60 frames (2026-11-12 05:44)
